integrity: Theorem derives from elementary field-linear algebra; direct small-case enumerations corroborate but do not establish its unrestricted proof. No independent validation is claimed.
limitations: Finite-field limits take q to infinity through prime powers with the cycle length and dimension fixed; finite enumeration is only a cross-check. The exact stratum count concerns labeled modules with equal vertex dimensions and radical-square-zero relations, not arbitrary dimension vectors or higher Loewy length. Publication priority remains subject to comparison with possible equivalent cyclic-complex counts.
title: A parity law for generic projectivity in cyclic radical-square-zero module spaces
